title: It Rains Swords Here. Mine Is Bigger Than the Castle. (Part 1)
summary: Fold chooses an empty field for his falling sword and, with Nell beside him, raises a wall of steel between two kingdoms.
frame_0: A castle-sized sword hangs point down above Fold in an empty circle of street. Other kids stand beside their swords at the edges, beneath the opening title and countdown.
package_differences: Jake requested one moving shot through the closing question. The Flashloop card follows at the specified time.
